She was very stressed, hurt, and just not herself, so I was really worried about her. Everyone at the clinic was so kind, caring, and understanding. They took great care of Athena and made me feel like she was in good hands. I’m so grateful for everything they did to help her.

Thank you for your feedback — I'm sorry to hear your experience fell short of expectations. We take concerns seriously and would like to make this right; please contact our customer care team through our website or by calling our main line so we can address what went wrong. We appreciate you bringing this to our attention and hope to resolve it promptly.

Excellent and very professional. My mom has been taking her kittens there for years. I went this Saturday and was helped by a very understanding assistant. And the doctor was very professional and sexy, a man with glasses and green eyes who clearly has a lot of experience and knows what he’s doing. He explained everything to me very patiently, and I was very satisfied. It’s a bit far from where I live, but as long as my baby is always treated by a doctor like that, the distance doesn’t matter.
Thank you, Viny Dos Santos, for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and are glad you had a great experience. We look forward to serving you again soon.

I’ve been to this veterinarian three times before, always because their prices used to be reasonable. This time, I came in for a simple annual rabies vaccine and they handed me an estimate of over $800. They added multiple services I never requested, including an annual insurance plan for my dog.
Even after I complained and showed them my previous bills from their own clinic, they only adjusted the estimate back to the usual price, around 100$. But at that point, the experience was already unacceptable.
What bothered me the most was the manipulative language the staff used — telling me that if I didn’t agree to certain treatments, my dog will die, and I repeat I came just for an annual vaccine. Completely unprofessional, fear-based tactics. I decided to walk out without getting the vaccine and I will never be coming back.

Thank you, Maria del Carmen Ramon, for your wonderful 5-star review! We're delighted to hear that you had a great experience with us. Your feedback is greatly appreciated and motivates us to continue providing excellent service. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

thank you..... i appreciate all the help with my pet blue. As soon as i walked in, i was immediately attended and they urgently got the tests done and thank god my baby blue is ok. Special thanks to the doctor and technician for being patient with my nervousness. Thank you.

I had an excellent experience at this veterinary clinic. The receptionist, Isabella, was incredibly kind and attentive her friendliness and warm attitude really stood out. We were very well taken care of at the clinic, and I truly appreciated the way she treated us. It made our visit very pleasant. I will definitely be coming back and highly recommend this clinic for their outstanding service.

I brought my baby for a simple nail trim and to purchase her preventive heart worm medication. I even brought the box with the labels showing her monthly schedule—she’s due in August. However, the clinic insisted that according to their records, she was overdue since last month. They refused to sell me the medication unless I agreed to a blood test plus additional services, which would total almost $600 including a yearly plan.

I understand vet clinics are businesses and times are tough, but there should be a balance between making money and actually caring for our pets. I only came for preventive medication and a nail trim, not a sales pitch for unnecessary services. I requested my pet’s records and will be taking her elsewhere. There are plenty of vet clinics in Miami that prioritize care over profit.

They did a very, very good job. They spayed my cat and my three dogs. I prefer to take them there . They have 24 hours that you can call them if you have any problems with your animal. God forbid if there’s any problem they will make sure they resolve the issue and the concern Immediately. And there are very affordable
I am greatfull for the attention they have given to me when I go. They are amazing with the help they give. I strongly recommend to go to Miami Animal clinic. The best!

The worst place for your pet. On every call, all they care about is making up excuses to squeeze money out of you, and they charge exorbitant prices. A short, white, somewhat overweight man with light eyes was inept in every way he treated my pet, and everyone else was just laughing and joking in front of the office. I don't know if he was the doctor or a nurse, but he was complaining because my dog ​​was barking and saying, "Watch out, she'll bite me!" They're clearly not specialists in animals like dogs and cats; they don't know how to treat them or handle them patiently. They work out of necessity, not devotion. A terrible place... absolutely terrible and ridiculously expensive.
Excellent service. They have a very well-organized team. Their doctor was spot on with the diagnosis and treatment for my kitten. Thank you, you've brightened my life and my pet's.

You leave with everything you need: the explanation, the treatment, and the satisfaction of knowing everyone treated you with so much love and professionalism. The clinic is quite far from our house, but we will definitely continue to choose this place.

In the end, I paid $50 just for them to tell me they couldn’t do anything…

To top it off, the receptionist was extremely rude. She called my cat a "stray" — which is not only wrong but totally insulting. I’m so glad I didn’t go through with the surgery here, I can’t imagine what would have happened.

If you can't properly care for cats, maybe you shouldn't be running an "animal" clinic. Don’t waste your time or money here these people are a disgrace to the profession!!!
